description: This file defines API endpoints and handlers for managing roles in the Mattermost server, including retrieving, patching, and listing roles with permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Represents the API handler with route initialization for role management.

methods.name: InitRole
methods.description: Initializes role-related API routes with associated handlers.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Handles retrieving all roles, with permission check.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Handles retrieving a specific role by ID.

methods.name: getRoleByName
methods.description: Handles retrieving a role by name.

methods.name: getRolesByNames
methods.description: Handles retrieving multiple roles by their names.

methods.name: patchRole
methods.description: Handles updating a role with permission and validation checks.
